paragraphs: I'm applying for the Sr. Analyst, Strategic Finance role at Sparrow. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested because this is the first strategic finance hire, working directly with the CFO, and leave management is a real problem that a lot of companies handle badly.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst. I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I created AI-powered analytical dashboards that automated reporting workflows. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked as a consultant on marketing-channel budget allocation, built models to evaluate $10M in spend, and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership.

That maps to owning the operating model, building automated analyses, and helping decide where budget goes. I'm comfortable working without a big team around me, and I'd enjoy helping build the function from the start. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
